column1: # Accepted content of the CDM 5.38.0 reference Java files whose bytes differed between independent
# runs of the released generator (rosetta-maven-plugin 9.83.0 on the pinned public commit).
# EVERY row is a form produced by a released-generator run named in cdm-5.38.0.mode0-witnesses.json;
# nothing here was rendered by the replacement implementation. A form no witnessed run produced is
# NOT accepted: the verifier reports it as unverifiedOrdering.
# Columns: path (relative to test-corpus/), variant index, SHA-256 raw, SHA-256 after CRLF->LF, witnesses
# (R = the retained frozen baseline reference; W1, W2 = the two independent 2026-09-22 regenerations),
# retainedReference (true for the form recorded in cdm-5.38.0.sha256).
